title: Snakes Found Inside Airport: Venomous western browns spotted in terminal; experts explain heat-driven visits
summary_full: As summer approaches, Alice Springs Airport is preparing for an influx of snake sightings, with multiple reports emerging from terminal areas. In response, the airport management has put in place monitoring systems and hired professionals for safe snake removal. Travelers are encouraged to remain alert and immediately report any sightings to airport personnel, emphasizing safety first in this reptilian season.
